LaunchId.description: A launch: one process lifetime of a thread.

oneOf.description: This stop sealed and killed the launch.
The launch had already exited with its death confirmed.

The owner's assertion confirmed the launch's end, now or earlier; only for a request
with `assume_dead`.

StopResult.description:
The success body of `stop` (`docs/design/supervisor.md` §2.2). Every field is always
present, `exit_code` and `signal` as `null` when unknown, and each is in the JSON
Schema's `required` list.

confirmed_within_deadline.description: Death was confirmed and proven at or before the request's start + 5 s.

death_confirmed.description: The launch's process tree was proven dead.

exit_code.description:
The leader's exit code; `null` when the waiter had not reported an exit, and for
`already_exited` (the launch's own `launch_exited` carries it).

ThreadId.description: A thread: one agent conversation across all its launches.

description:
The success body of `close`: `stop` is the result of the stop a `close --stop` ran, and
`null` when none ran.
title: CloseResult
